If you want the **best all-around tire installation in Pleasanton**, I’d start with **Big O Tires on Washington St** and **Seever & Sons Tire / Big Brand Tire on Old Santa Rita Rd**. Both are local, established tire shops that explicitly offer tire mounting/installation and related services; Big O highlights ASE-certified technicians and says they can mount and balance tires, including tires bought elsewhere, while Seever & Sons/Big Brand offers new tire replacement plus alignment checks and other maintenance.[1][8][10][3]

A practical way to choose:

| Shop | Why consider it | Installation notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Big O Tires** | Strong local tire-service focus; ASE-certified technicians; handles tires bought elsewhere | Says it will properly and safely mount new tires and mount/balance flat repairs[8][10][1] |
| **Seever & Sons Tire / Big Brand Tire** | Local Pleasanton location with full tire and auto service menu | Offers tire replacement, flat repair, wheel alignment checks, and maintenance[3][4] |
| **Tire Choice Auto Service Center** | Broad brand selection and long hours, including Sundays | Says it stocks thousands of tires and is ready for replacement and installation[13][19] |

For **buying tires**, the best fit depends on what matters most:

- **Best for convenience and tire installation:** **Big O Tires** or **Tire Choice** because both emphasize installation and service in-house.[8][10][19]
- **Best for a full-service local shop:** **Seever & Sons / Big Brand Tire** because it combines tire replacement with alignment and general auto maintenance.[3][4]
- **Best if you already bought tires online:** **Big O Tires** explicitly says it will install tires purchased elsewhere.[10]

If you want the shortest answer: **Big O Tires on Washington St is the safest first pick for installation**, and **Seever & Sons / Big Brand on Old Santa Rita Rd is the strongest alternative for full-service work**.[8][10][3]
